title: Injifataa Horizons Lama Gidduu Jiru
intro: Seenaa qajeelfama waaqaa keessatti fakkiin tokko akka bulchaa jabaa fi gabricha Rabbii gad of deebisu ta’ee adda ba’ee dhaabata. Namni dhuunfaa kun gara lafa fagootti kan imalu siʼa taʼu, aduun namoota hin baratamne tokko irratti baatee burqaa gurraacha dukkanaaʼaa taʼe tokko keessatti lixuu argeera. Hunda caalaa kan nama dinqisiisu hojjetaan kun saba hammeenya guddaa qabu irratti gufuu adda taʼe ijaaruuf itti kenname. Nama sheekkoo kana Qur'aana irraa adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Aangoo fi dhiibbaan dachii irratti Rahmaan naaf kenne
Bakka aduun baatee itti lixxutti imalaan ture
Ummata jecha tokkollee hubachuu dadhabe bira gahe
Sibiilli fayyadamee danqaa guddaa akkan ijaaru na ajajame
Bakka gaarreen cirrachaa lama gidduu jiru sibiilli baqfameen cufe
Ani malaaykaas ta’ee nabiyyii osoo hin taane, gabricha Rabbiin tola itti kenne ture

trial.answer: Yajuj fi Majuj irratti danqaa sibiilaa guddaa ijaaruu

location.answer: Bakka aduun baatee fi burqaa dhoqqee gurraacha

outcome.answer: Gufuun hanga Guyyaa Qiyaamaatti ni tura

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
